Subject: Amara Singh — debrief, missing scorecards & tie-break request

Thanks team — quick debrief from the on-site loop yesterday with Amara Singh (SWE, Backend). We have a near-complete set of notes but two outstanding scorecards: Mina and Marissa, I only see partial rubrics in the drive. Can you please do the following by EOD Monday (Nov 30):

- Fill the attached scorecard template or upload your file with numeric rubric (1-5) and a short justification.
- Add any red flags or takeaways under the Decision notes section.

Quick summary for context:
- Strong system design (scale, trade-offs) with a clear caching and sharding rationale.
- Some concern on long-term ownership signals; asked vague questions about team structure a couple of times.
- Behavioral fit looked solid.

If we need a tie-break vote I will include it in the thread. Marissa, can you confirm hiring threshold: average 3.5+ versus 4.0+? Attaching template: Amara_Singh_scorecard_template.xlsx

Thanks — Sofia

Uploaded my completed scorecard to the drive and attaching a local copy. Numeric summary: System design 4, Coding 3, Ownership 3, Culture 4. Overall average 3.5.

Notes:
- Loved the caching design and trade-offs discussion.
- Coding was fine but not exceptional; could be due to nerves.
- Ownership concerns are real but I think with a 30/60/90 roadmap and pairing with a senior engineer those gap areas can be mitigated.

Recommendation: Yes hire, with a 90-day ownership plan and an engineering buddy.

Apologies for the delay — had a family emergency yesterday morning. I attached my scorecard. Numeric summary: System design 3, Coding 4, Ownership 2, Culture 4. Average 3.25.

Concern to flag: in the async event handling discussion Amara leaned on third party services without detailing runtime fallbacks; that could be a problem for our reliability bar if left unchecked. If we proceed, we should put reliability SLAs into the onboarding goals.

My vote: Yes (leaning hire). Rationale: overall avg across submitted cards ~= 3.375, with solid system thinking and culture fit. Main caveat is ownership and reliability edge cases noted by Mina. If Marissa wants to be conservative, I support a hire at IC3 with explicit ownership milestones and a 30/60/90 mentoring assignment.

One-line: Yes, conditional on onboarding plan.

-Dylan

Subject: Final tally and next steps for Amara Singh

Thanks everyone for the quick turn. Tally so far: Marissa avg 3.5, Karthik 3.5, Mina 3.25, Dylan vote Yes conditional. Combined average across cards submitted = 3.44. Per Marissa earlier, threshold is 3.5+ to move unilaterally; we are marginally below that number but have consensus that the candidate is hireable with conditions.

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa to confirm hire level and any compensation guidance by EOD Tuesday Nov 31 (note: internal approvals on comp run Wed).
- I will request a 15 minute calibration call if Marissa wants one.
- Sahil, please hold any offer conversation until we confirm level and comp. If we greenlight, we will aim for an offer by Thursday Nov 3.

I uploaded a short decision notes file summarizing the panel concerns and recommended onboarding milestones: decision_notes_amarasingh.txt and added the doc link here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbCdEFgHIjkLz_debrief-notes

If Marissa gives the go-ahead with conditional IC3 hire and the 90-day milestone plan, I will draft a short note to candidate and loop in People Ops for offer prep.

Thanks — Sofia
